content.comment_body: Hello, I am looking to create a program in which two inputs will control two outputs. If input 1 is triggered first and input 2 second, output 1 should activate. Conversely, if input 2 is triggered first and input 1 second, output 2 should activate. Both inputs will remain active for a short period of time. Thank you in advance for any suggestions.
This is one possible approach to solve your problem.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is seeking advice on how to design a ladder logic program with a controller, where the order of input activation determines which output is triggered, and both inputs stay active for a few seconds. The only reply offered a general suggestion, without specific step-by-step guidance or examples.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to receive detailed programming guidance or example ladder logic code for the controller to achieve input order-based output control.
